title: Icons
intro: We use Phosphor Icons: consistent stroke, four weights and versions ready for Server Components.

library.title: Common icons
library.description: The most used icons in the HCP and admin.

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Pick the weight based on context, and don't mix weights within the same group.

care.title: Care icons
care.description: Each plan item type has its own color and icon, in a 40 px square with 10 px corners.

guidelines.do1: Icon-only buttons always have an aria-label.
guidelines.do2: Use icon + text for destructive or uncommon actions.
guidelines.dont1: Don't mix in other icon libraries.
guidelines.dont2: Don't use icons as the only status indicator.
